name: ironroot-frontier-desktop
description: Offline desktop shell for Ironroot Frontier

scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check security.cjs && node --check scripts/stage.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run stage && electron-builder --win zip --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run stage && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run stage && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --publish never
